description: This file defines a command handler class in the Fineract project responsible for handling delete operations for fixed deposit products. It implements an interface for command processing and delegates the delete action to the associated service.

classes.name: DeleteFixedDepositProductCommandHandler
classes.description: A service component that handles delete commands for fixed deposit products within the Fineract platform, annotated for command type association.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the delete command by invoking the delete method on the associated service using the entity ID from the command.
